consequence.statement: The -querier.engine.timeout flag and the corresponding YAML setting are removed, so they are no longer honoured if still configured.

original.statement: The already-deprecated -querier.engine.timeout CLI flag (and its YAML setting) is removed in Loki 3.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-da0f06f8da24] says that in Loki 3.0.0 both the `-querier.engine.timeout` CLI flag and its YAML setting are removed. A removed configuration key is exactly the case setting-ignored covers: any value still configured is no longer honoured, so this needs action rather than review. The evidence doesn't say whether a leftover flag or key makes Loki fail at startup instead. The proposed statement claims only that the value stops being honoured, so it doesn't over-claim.
